gaps: The required native Return admission, independent review and the full automatic nine-command C2/UAT have not run. The exact C2 command objects, environments and predicates (B11_C2_961_PREPARATION.json) are outside my readable scope. Locally I approximated build, package, focused, affected and artifact; source-correspondence, fixture-current-measurement, toolchain and contract-seeds were not run. All results are single unrepeated local runs; timings are not evidence.

In the real leaf-port dispatch order, an old-format native input is refused first by the generic isNativeWorkspaceWorkTask check in authority verification (implementation/leaf_invocation_port.ts, not granted), with an untyped authority_verification/refused. The typed unsupported_selection boundary is reached through the assembly and actor-preparation owners. The proof uses a component frontier with controlled basis/role premises, not a real Run or event log. Making the typed refusal come first in the full leaf-port path would need that ungranted owner; returned, not done.

The boundary covers only the native work task. Selector (framed_synthesis_task) and semantic-job Context inputs are unchanged. The selector's existing unknown_dependency refusal for an invalid Context was not separately proven.

Tracked canonical-generated files outside the grant were not written and are now stale against the edited source: contracts/worksite/command-execution-context.inventory.json (still 9c5716…; the build regenerates 89dbe9ba…), product-toolchain-manifest.json, test_env/fixtures/abi5-root-candidate-basis.json, and the whole-qualification test_env/qualification/inventory.json.

Residuals unchanged as selected: pending native contexts whose members name predecessor-Run holders still refuse foreign; cross-Run holder reuse and coordinate/native-identity rewrites are deferred; whole qualification/release and the original full P1 rubric keep their standing.

Possible latent issue, not exercised or changed: in instruction_assembly.ts the revision-selection decision view's contextView over sourceNativeWork.after still requires inline bodies and would throw on a member-carried after unless isCompleted short-circuits it.

Disclosed effects: the owned scratch dir $TMPDIR/abg-p1-03-fBYyqG (about 230 MB of build/test copies and logs) is left in place. No commit.
